text: Two-pass RO plus electrodeionisation, 2 x 100 %, conductivity < 0.1 uS/cm, silica < 10 ug/l, with capacity for continuous water injection at 50 % load on LDO; demineralised water storage 2 x 1,250 m3 (3 days of cycle make-up plus about 24 h of water injection); connection point for mobile demin trailers.
title: Demineralised water
